tracks
            .Where(t => t.AlbumUri != null)
            .GroupBy(t => t.AlbumUri!)
            .Select(g => new LocalAlbumSummary(
                AlbumUri: g.Key,
                Album: g.First().Album ?? "Unknown Album",
                Year: g.Max(x => x.Year),
                TrackCount: g.Count(),
                ArtworkUri: g.First().ArtworkUri))
            .OrderByDescending(a => a.Year ?? 0)
            .ThenBy(a => a.Album)
            .ToList
